findings.summary: The exporter input path is left as a hedge. export-authorization.ts needs --api-map, and export-pii.ts needs --data-model and --pii-model. Both read native inventories, and the retained candidates already exist under work/rounds/R-0039/reports/delivery/inventories/*.json.gz (api-map, data-model, data-model-pii). The packet should name these exact inputs. It should also require the refreshed registries to reproduce the current native_population_sha256 values exactly: authorization abe04205…c7c7, PII 191d7ec4…1d9d. Finally, it should state that a fresh `devai sense run inventory_regeneration` is out of scope, or treat it as STOP. Without this, 'actual supported outputs' leaves the native-custody choice to whoever executes. The existing STOP clause keeps this non-blocking.

The schema reference is ambiguous. There are two module-blueprint schemas. docs/framework/blueprints/module-blueprint.schema.json allows additional module properties, as the packet says. law/schemas/module-blueprint.schema.json (pinned in law/schemas/manifest.json) sets $defs.ModuleMeta to additionalProperties:false and does not list dependencies, ddlFile or devDependencies. The current BPs already fail that stricter schema, so this change adds no new violation. Still, the 'actual complete schema resolver' step should name the docs/framework schema and say that law/schemas/ModuleMeta is not the resolver for these BPs, so a reviewer does not read a red result as caused by this change.

BP-INF-AIT-001 and BP-PORTAL-REQUESTS-001 already declare module.devDependencies {@types/pg, pg}. For them, the edit inserts a key into an existing object; the other three BPs get a new object. The generated key order then depends on where 'vite' goes, e.g. vitest,@types/pg,pg,vite. The deep-equality-with-key-order allowance covers either placement, but the packet should say which placement to use so the preview is deterministic.

The generator spreads module.devDependencies after the default vitest (lines 503–507). header() at line 126 uses only bp.id, module.version and the raw sha, and writes one line, so adding devDependencies changes only the sha.
